1.title: Graham Platner Files Paperwork to Withdraw From Maine Senate Race
1.summary: The move paved the way for Democrats to choose a new nominee to challenge Senator Susan Collins in a race both parties see as key to the control of the Senate.

2.title: The Platner Drama Is Reviving Debate Among Democrats Over a Double Standard
2.summary: His candidacy stoked tensions among Democrats over gender and how to win back working-class voters.

3.title: As the World Cup Wraps in L.A., the 2028 Olympics Beckon
3.summary: Hundreds of thousands of people took public transit to World Cup events in car-crazy Los Angeles, a hopeful sign for officials planning the Summer Games.

4.title: New dinosaur species with neck as long as cricket pitch discovered in Thailand
4.summary: The plant-eating dinosaur, named Uragasaurus kalasinensis, is thought to have lived about 150 million years ago.

5.title: Royal Rapprochement: Harry and Meghan Pay a Rare Visit to the King and Queen
5.summary: Friday’s visit to King Charles and Queen Camilla signaled a détente in relations with Prince Harry and his wife, who stepped down from royal duties and moved to the United States in 2020.

6.title: Can Hungarian Holocaust Survivors Find Justice in the U.S.?
6.summary: For more than a decade, a group of survivors have fought a legal battle to get American courts to hear their suit against Hungary’s national railroad over its role in the atrocities.
